steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the laundry center or disconnect power before servicing the dryer section. Timer and start switch are intentionally ungrounded — shock risk if power is on during access.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Timer may present electric shock during servicing.

steps.title: Confirm electric dryer section
steps.body: GUD27ESSMWW / XUD27ESSMWW = electric heat. GUD27GSS = gas — use gas no-heat procedure instead.
steps.sourceExcerpt: GUD27ESSMWW / XUD27ESSMWW = electric heat. GUD27GSS = gas — use gas no-heat procedure instead.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Use gegud27-no-heat-gas for GUD27GSS gas dryer section.

steps.title: 240 VAC at both supply legs
steps.body: At terminal block with power on: measure 240 VAC across both hot legs. Each leg to neutral ~120 VAC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At terminal block with power on: measure 240 VAC across both hot legs. Each leg to neutral ~120 VAC.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Correct 240 V supply or cord/terminal block fault.

steps.title: 240 VAC at both heater elements
steps.body: During heat call with drum running: verify 240 VAC present at heater element terminals per wiring diagram p.77.
steps.sourceExcerpt: During heat call with drum running: verify 240 VAC present at heater element terminals per wiring diagram p.77.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Check motor switch M1–M2, timer heat contacts, and heat selector per §60 chart.

steps.title: Thermostat temperature operation
steps.body: Verify cycling thermostats open/close at rated temps (inlet 210°F, outlet 130°F, high-limit 315°F, safety 235°F).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify cycling thermostats open/close at rated temps (inlet 210°F, outlet 130°F, high-limit 315°F, safety 235°F).

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace failed biased thermostat(s); clear vent if safety tripped.

steps.title: Element resistance
steps.body: Power off. Run gegud27-heater-thermostats-electric for outer/inner element Ω and thermostat continuity.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Run gegud27-heater-thermostats-electric for outer/inner element Ω and thermostat continuity.

steps.title: Timer, motor switch, heat selector
steps.body: Verify timer B–A / Y–S heat contacts, motor centrifugal M1–M2, and heat selector switch per §62 timer chart.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify timer B–A / Y–S heat contacts, motor centrifugal M1–M2, and heat selector switch per §62 timer chart.

steps.title: Correct supply
steps.oemOutcome: Restore 240 VAC supply or replace cord/terminal block.

steps.title: Electric heat path reviewed
steps.oemOutcome: Supply, voltage path, thermostats, and element checks complete per §60.
